title: Symptom Stacking
idea: "RYZE ad 2" (Briefs for HS, Brief #17). 1:1 of a Ryze mushroom coffee Pixar-style song ad ("It's not normal…", 1:31, posted as "made $71K in 8 days, 3,000 bookmarks"): a sung symptom stack (pooping once a week, farts that reek, six months pregnant after eating, puffy face to feet), "not your fault, you're backed up", then the product, with the woman going RED (bloated) to BLUE (calm). Same song, shots and red-to-blue character; the product is our castor oil roll-on + cotton belly wrap, and the mechanism is castor oil soaking in and the warm wrap getting things moving. The song makes the symptom call-out (our #1 opener) catchy and rewatchable. Bloating backed by our winners #294 ("six months pregnant"), #303, #305 and Skeleton (#10); mechanism = Johnny's castor oil pack explanation cut to the reference's length. Offer matches the site pop-up (50% off + a free bottle) so the ad and the landing page say the same thing.

Same first frame and same visuals for both hooks. Only the header text changes (H1 has a header, H2 is captions only).

editing_notes:
THE HOOK IS THE MOST IMPORTANT PART OF THIS AD. The first frame and first line must stop the scroll and make the problem obvious with the sound off. Spend the most time here, and redo it until it's undeniable.

Replicate this format exactly: Reference (link above: the video in the X post; it's a Ryze mushroom coffee song ad, 1:31, posted as "made $71K in 8 days, 3,000 bookmarks"). SAME SONG, SAME SHOTS, SAME RED → BLUE CHARACTER. Only swaps: the product is our castor oil roll-on + cotton belly wrap, and the mechanism is castor oil soaking in and the warm wrap getting things moving (instead of mushrooms and gut bacteria).

HOOKS (2): both hooks use the same sung line, the same first frame and the same visuals. Only the header changes: H1 has the header "How to de-bloat / in 35 days 👇" (white box, top, on the first frame); H2 has no header, captions only.

ALL CHARACTERS ARE WHITE (Caucasian).

PROOF BEHIND THIS AD: the reference's reported results above; Ryze is one of the biggest DTC brands on Meta. Bloating angle = our winners #294 ("six months pregnant"), #303, #305, Skeleton (#10). Mechanism = Johnny's castor oil pack explanation, cut to the reference's length.

FRAME BY FRAME: every Visual cell goes line by line (lyric → the one shot to show, with the reference timestamp it copies). Same camera, framing, color and timing.

PRODUCT: wherever the reference shows the Ryze bag, the coffee or the mushrooms (ref 0:36-1:03, 1:24), show OUR amber roll-on + the cotton belly wrap in the same 3D style, built from the real product photos (Products tab).

CLAIMS (go strong, like the reference): "more regular poops" and "less bloated and backed up" are the strongest.

OFFER: 50% off plus a free bottle (the same offer as the pop-up that appears when she lands on havenspool.co, so the ad and the site match) + the 30-day money-back guarantee card like the reference (ref 1:24). Show the offer as its own card right after the guarantee card, copying the site pop-up (described in the CTA Visual cell). Landing page: Bloating page.

Doc: Briefs for HS, tab "RYZE ad 2" (Brief #17).

Voiceover: Sung by an AI female vocalist exactly like the reference: same melody, same key, same tempo, same soft emotional pop style, every lyric sung clearly so it's understood on the first listen. It must sound like a real singer, never robotic. NEEDS TO HAVE CONVICTION in their voice, its boring to listen to a dull script. They need to speak with character.

Avatar: Pixar-style 3D characters exactly like the reference, but she and every person (coworkers etc.) are WHITE (Caucasian) with white features; the red / blue is a color glow over her skin to show her mood, like the reference, not her ethnicity.
HER: a woman with big curly hair, white crop tee and grey joggers. RED skin, swollen belly and a fiery mood while she's bloated (ref 0:03-0:39); BLUE skin, flat belly and calm once the wrap works (ref 0:42-1:27). Same character throughout.
The "backed-up" characters: little grumpy green blobs pushing carts of waste through a pink tunnel (ref 0:21-0:30); they turn into happy blue blobs relaxing in the tunnel at the end (ref 0:51, 1:18).
